newsitem.title: UK: Bankers Trust appoints senior advisor in Frankfurt.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust appoints senior advisor in Frankfurt.

text.p: Bankers Trust said on Thursday it had appointed Wolfgang Graebner as senior advisor to Bankers Trust International Plc's Frankfurt branch.

Graebner will work closely with Philippe Souviron, senior managing director and head of the firm's European client origination group and Wolfgang Handel, managing director in the Frankfurt office, Bankers Trust said in a statement.
Bankers Trust said Graebner would help develop new strategies for Bankers Trust's activities in the German marketplace with particular emphasis on corporate finance.
